cards.title: Call Tower when number one
cards.leadIn: Do not call while waiting in sequence:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Navy Corpus Tower, <callsign>, ready for departure, Portland low departure.

exchange.speaker: Tower
exchange.text: <callsign>, Navy Corpus Tower, winds <wind>, cleared for takeoff RWY {from.runway}.

cards.title: Climb out RWY {from.runway} toward Point Silver
instructions: Follow the Portland departure track from RWY {from.runway} to Point Silver, due north of KNGP
cards.detail: The sources give only the name, the Tower call and the track on the map. Altitudes, airspeeds and turn points are not written down. Check with an instructor.

cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: When directed by Tower, contact Corpus Departure (UHF CH 12), then switch to CH 8 when directed:

radio.script: “Corpus Departure, <callsign>, off Navy Corpus, Portland low.”

cards.detail: The check-in phrase is assumed. Check with an instructor.
